import os, subprocess, json, glob, time

drive='.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py'
env=os.environ.copy();
env.update({
  'DRIVE_SESSION_TAG':'nothingness_linux_debug',
  'DRIVE_TARGET':'linux',
  'DRIVE_RUN_LOG':'/tmp/flutter_run_nothingness_linux_debug.log',
  'DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO':'/tmp/flutter_input_nothingness_linux_debug',
  'DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME':'/tmp/nothingness_nothingness_linux_debug',
})
fixtures=sorted(glob.glob('/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus'))
paths_csv=','.join(fixtures)

def parse_json_output(out: str):
    s=out.strip(); first=s.find('{'); last=s.rfind('}')
    return json.loads(s[first:last+1])

def run(args):
    out=subprocess.check_output([drive]+args, env=env, text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    return parse_json_output(out)

print('queue')
run(['call','ext.nothingness.setQueue',f'paths={paths_csv}','startIndex=0'])

print('open settings')
run(['settings','open'])

print('tap')
res=run(['tap','void-settings-status-shuffle'])
print('tap res', res)

st=run(['inspect'])
print('shuffle after tap', st['playback']['shuffle'])
for i in range(20):
    time.sleep(0.15)
    st=run(['inspect'])
    if st['playback']['shuffle']:
        print('became true at', i)
        break
    else:
        print('still false', i)
